title: The Slot Pattern & Polymorphic `asChild` API
problemStatement:
Allowing consumers to merge component behavior and props into custom elements or Next.js/React Router Link components using Radix UI's Slot architecture.

**Enterprise Importance**:
Solves the classic 'Button that needs to be an `<a>` or Next.js `<Link>`' problem cleanly without DOM wrapper pollution or invalid HTML nesting.
interviewTrap: Rendering an `<a>` tag inside a `<button>` tag (invalid HTML) or nesting multiple interactive focusable elements.

detailedExplanation.conceptualOverview: The Slot component clones its direct child and merges its own props, event handlers, and refs onto that child rather than rendering its own DOM element.
stepByStepWalkthrough: 1. Design Token Layer: Primitives, semantic aliases, and component tokens established.
2. Component Architecture: Headless state and keyboard accessibility hooks implemented.
3. Styling & Cascade: Zero-runtime CSS variables and layer specificity managed.
4. Governance & Packaging: Tree-shaking, semantic versioning, and telemetry monitored.
